title: Outcome Source Citation Gap
dataSources: Forecasts (`forecast:personal`), journal reviews (`forecast:journal`), resolved outcomes (`forecast:resolution`), calibration scores (`forecast:calibration`), ops reviews (`forecast:ops`).
app: Personal forecasting telemetry — Metaculus personal predictions, private prediction-journal entries, and calibration-bin scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forecast:resolution source_name=* citation_added=*
| stats sum(eval(if(citation_added="no",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by source_name
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending missing citations backlog by outcome source for resolution write-ups.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside resolution write-ups.
implementation: Mark each `forecast:resolution` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `source_name`.
visualization: Table of outcome source with pending missing citations counts.
grandmaExplanation: It frames where unfinished missing citations are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in resolution write-ups.
